questions.text: Read the forum discussion about phobias. Decide if each statement is true or false.

context.text:
Sunny: Fear can protect us, but phobias can make ordinary life difficult because we may fear things that are not really dangerous. Some people are so afraid of open spaces that they will not go to the park or out of the house.

Freddy: Fear of animals like snakes comes from an old human instinct because some snakes are dangerous.

Mary Lou: A small dog scared me when I was very young, so now I want to run away whenever I see a dog.

answers.text: Sunny thinks phobias can protect us from danger.
People afraid of open spaces do not leave their homes.
Freddy thinks all snakes are dangerous.
Mary Lou is a little child now.
Mary Lou does not like dogs.

questions.explanation: Sunny says fear can protect us, but phobias can make life difficult. Freddy says some snakes are dangerous, not all of them. Mary Lou is now afraid of dogs.

questions.text: Put the dialogue in the correct order.

order_items.text: Elena: Hey Mina, how about going shopping this afternoon?
Mina: Sure, that sounds great! Why don't we meet at the shopping centre?
Elena: Good idea. What about 10 a.m. at the entrance?
Mina: Sorry, Elena, I have to finish my homework.
Elena: That's OK. How about tomorrow morning?
Mina: Yes, that sounds fine. See you tomorrow!

questions.explanation: Elena invites Mina; Mina cannot go today; Elena suggests tomorrow; Mina agrees and suggests the shopping centre; Elena suggests 10 a.m.; Mina confirms.
